activity.evidence_source: Palm Hills Developments consolidated financial statements H1 2026, note 2 (Company's purpose): to invest in real estate in the New Cities and New Urban Communities including building, constructing, owning and managing residential compounds, resorts, villas and touristic villages, selling and resale of associated services and facilities, leasing and construction of integrated projects — real-estate development, a permissible activity.

statement_period.label: H1 2026 — six months ended 30 June 2026 (consolidated, periodic, limited-review)

non_compliant_revenue_breakdown.label: Credit interest and Returns on investments Measured at Amortized cost
non_compliant_revenue_breakdown.reason: Yield / returns on financial investments at amortised cost (treasury bills, government bonds, time deposits) -- counted wherever presented: finance income, other income, or other revenues.
non_compliant_revenue_breakdown.basis: The company's interest-income line: credit interest plus returns on the treasury bills/bonds held at amortized cost (note 47); the statements do not split the line further. Cross-tie: the cash-flow statement shows 'Collected interest and returns on investments at amortized cost' of exactly 455,606,067 (PHDC H1-2026 snapshot provenance, issue #326).

non_compliant_revenue_breakdown.label: Amortization of discount on notes receivables
non_compliant_revenue_breakdown.reason: Amortisation / unwinding of discount on notes receivable -- implicit interest on deferred customer payments, counted wherever presented outside the finance-income note.
non_compliant_revenue_breakdown.basis: Discount unwinding on customer notes receivable - implicit interest on deferred customer payments (PHDC H1-2026 snapshot provenance, issue #326).

non_compliant_revenue_breakdown.label: Gains on financial investments at FVPL
non_compliant_revenue_breakdown.reason: Fair-value gain on financial investments at FVPL -- a revaluation gain, not interest.

non_compliant_revenue_breakdown.label: Transfer fees and delay penalties
non_compliant_revenue_breakdown.reason: Line identified as not interest-type; the line's 'basis' must name why.
non_compliant_revenue_breakdown.basis: Service fees charged to customers, not interest; part of total revenue, not of non-compliant income (PHDC H1-2026 snapshot provenance, issue #326).
